spans.s: कुण् vt. 6P (pp. कुणित) 1. To support, to aid; 2. to sound.
कूण् (I) vt. 10U (pp. कूणित) To speak, to converse.
कूण् (II) vi. 10Ā (pp. कूणित; pres. कूणयते) To contract, to close.
कुणक m. A young animal just born.
कुणप (I) a. (f. पी) smelling like a dead body.
कुणप (II) m.n. 1. A dead body, a corpse, अमेध्यः कुणपाशी च M.xii.71; 2. an epithet of contempt.
कुणप (III) m. 1. A spear; 2. a foul smell.
कुणप (I) a. (f. पी) smelling like a dead body.
कुणि m. A cripple with a withered arm.
कूणिका f. 1. The horn of any animal; 2. the peg of a lute.
